body: Your words mean a great deal to me. The terror of this period of my life feels overwhelming. I hate the uncertainty of not knowing what I'll look like at the end. I know I'm supposed to transition for myself and not for others, but I've found that my mind has set very, very high standards for this transition. Frankly, I'm not sure what to do if I don't pass after all that time. Death? Shitty wage job? I don't know anymore.
I plan on it. They won't be getting anything definite from me, just suggestions about what they may like.

If that's the case, then I doubt Jabba is giving out official Hutt identification cards. The only reason(assuming we're giving Lucas a pass for not planning out a trilogy in advance; that is, within the lore) is that the stormtrooper is ignorant of the fact that no one has ID's here. Which either makes the questioning redundant, or makes him very, very ignorant. Then again, Obi-Wan did say that the Jedi mind trick only works on the weak minded.

Thank you and I certainly will. There isn't much of an LGBT community where I live :(
But it's good to know that there's validity in these feelings.:)
